title: A Bolton Repairman Built The First Self-Winding Watch
hook: John Harwood, a Bolton watch repairer, patented a self-winding wristwatch on 7 July 1923. A weighted arm bumps a ratchet to wind the spring. Rolex acknowledged him in 1956.
why: Evergreen tension story with a clear mechanism explainer. Modern rotors (e.g. Rolex Datejust 41, $8,950 white dial) as the comparison.
